intro: The NX Pro Keylock Safe blends robust security with effortless access. Crafted for your peace of mind, it offers ultimate protection for your valuables with advanced safety features.

features.title: Twin solid steel shooting bolts
features.text: Double the defense. With twin solid steel shooting bolts, your valuables stay locked tight, safe from unauthorized access and ensuring maximum security.

features.title: Advanced keylock
features.text: Simple, secure access. The Godrej Curvo Ultra Key Lock delivers reliable protection with a straightforward mechanism, ensuring your belongings are always within reach yet safe from harm.

features.title: Mounting & grouting for extra security
features.text: Secure the locker with anchor bolts to walls, floors, or shelves, providing added resistance against tampering or unauthorized removal for peace of mind.

features.title: Tough metal build for unmatched durability
features.text: Small yet mighty. Despite its compact size, this locker offers superior strength and durability, providing reliable, long-lasting protection for your valuables.

features.title: Interior carpet for gentle care
features.text: Protect your delicate items with a soft carpet lining that cushions and prevents scratches, ensuring your valuables remain pristine and secure.

name: Nx Pro 33 Litres Steel Manual Home Locker
